aliases.title: CPI m/m
aliases.justification: FF CPI m/m is the US headline monthly CPI percent change; unqualified non-staged monthly release.

aliases.title: CPI y/y
aliases.justification: FF CPI y/y is the US headline annual CPI percent change; unqualified non-staged monthly release.

aliases.title: Core CPI m/m
aliases.justification: FF explicitly says Core CPI m/m, matching the US CPI excluding food and energy monthly change.

aliases.title: Core CPI y/y
aliases.justification: FF explicitly says Core CPI y/y, matching the US CPI excluding food and energy annual change.

aliases.title: GDP m/m
aliases.justification: FF GDP m/m identifies UK monthly GDP growth, not quarterly or rolling three-month growth.

aliases.title: Final CPI y/y
aliases.justification: FF EUR Final CPI y/y identifies final euro-area headline HICP; EA21 applies only to explicit periods from 2026-01.

aliases.title: Non-Farm Employment Change
aliases.justification: FF Non-Farm Employment Change: BLS total nonfarm payroll monthly net change, SA, thousands of persons.

aliases.title: Advance GDP q/q
aliases.justification: FF Advance GDP q/q: BEA real GDP quarter-on-quarter growth at a seasonally adjusted annual rate; advance estimate.

aliases.title: Prelim GDP q/q
aliases.justification: FF Prelim GDP q/q: FF preliminary GDP is BEA's second estimate of SA annualized quarterly real GDP growth.

aliases.title: Final GDP q/q
aliases.justification: FF Final GDP q/q: FF final GDP is BEA's third estimate of SA annualized quarterly real GDP growth.

aliases.title: PPI m/m
aliases.justification: FF PPI m/m: BLS final-demand headline producer prices, SA monthly percent change; excludes Core PPI.

aliases.title: PPI y/y
aliases.justification: FF PPI y/y: BLS final-demand headline producer prices, NSA twelve-month percent change.

aliases.title: JOLTS Job Openings
aliases.justification: FF JOLTS Job Openings: BLS total nonfarm job openings, SA level, scaled to thousands of persons.

aliases.title: PCE Price Index m/m
aliases.justification: FF PCE Price Index m/m: BEA headline SA monthly PCE price change; price inflation, not consumption spending.

aliases.title: PCE Price Index y/y
aliases.justification: FF PCE Price Index y/y: BEA headline SA twelve-month PCE price change; price inflation, not consumption spending.

aliases.title: Core PCE Price Index m/m
aliases.justification: FF Core PCE Price Index m/m: BEA SA monthly PCE price change excluding food and energy; price inflation, not consumption spending.

aliases.title: Core PCE Price Index y/y
aliases.justification: FF Core PCE Price Index y/y: BEA SA twelve-month PCE price change excluding food and energy; price inflation, not consumption spending.

aliases.title: Retail Sales m/m
aliases.justification: FF Retail Sales m/m: Census advance nominal retail and food services sales, SA monthly percent change.

aliases.title: Core Retail Sales m/m
aliases.justification: FF Core Retail Sales m/m: Census advance nominal retail sales excluding motor vehicles and parts, SA monthly change; FF core means ex-auto here.

aliases.title: Housing Starts
aliases.justification: FF Housing Starts: Census new privately owned housing starts, total SA annual rate; count scaled to thousands of units.

aliases.title: Building Permits
aliases.justification: FF Building Permits: Census new privately owned housing authorized by permits, total SA annual rate; count scaled to thousands of units.

aliases.title: Durable Goods Orders m/m
aliases.justification: FF Durable Goods Orders m/m: Census advance manufacturers' durable goods new orders, SA monthly percent change.

aliases.title: Core Durable Goods Orders m/m
aliases.justification: FF Core Durable Goods Orders m/m: Census advance durable goods new orders excluding transportation, SA monthly change; FF core means ex-transport here.

aliases.title: Industrial Production m/m
aliases.justification: FF Industrial Production m/m: Federal Reserve total industry output, SA monthly percent change.

aliases.title: Capacity Utilization Rate
aliases.justification: FF Capacity Utilization Rate: Federal Reserve total industry capacity utilization, SA percent level, not a monthly change.

aliases.title: Trade Balance
aliases.justification: FF Trade Balance: Joint Census/BEA total goods and services balance on a balance-of-payments basis, SA, billions of USD.

aliases.title: CPI y/y
aliases.justification: FF CPI y/y: ONS all-items headline CPI twelve-month rate, NSA; excludes UK CPI m/m and RPI.

aliases.title: Core CPI y/y
aliases.justification: FF Core CPI y/y: ONS CPI excluding energy, food, alcohol and tobacco, NSA twelve-month rate.

aliases.title: Unemployment Rate
aliases.justification: FF Unemployment Rate: ONS ILO unemployment rate age 16+, SA three-month window ending in the issuer reference month.

aliases.title: Average Earnings Index 3m/y
aliases.justification: FF Average Earnings Index 3m/y: ONS total average weekly earnings including bonuses, SA three-month average annual growth; not regular pay excluding bonuses.

aliases.title: Prelim Flash GDP q/q
aliases.justification: FF Prelim Flash GDP q/q: Eurostat preliminary flash real GDP quarterly growth, seasonal and calendar adjusted, EA21.

aliases.title: Flash GDP q/q
aliases.justification: FF Flash GDP q/q: Eurostat second (flash) real GDP quarterly growth, seasonal and calendar adjusted, EA21.

aliases.title: Revised GDP q/q
aliases.justification: FF Revised GDP q/q: Eurostat regular main-aggregates real GDP quarterly growth, seasonal and calendar adjusted, EA21.

aliases.title: Unemployment Claims
aliases.justification: FF Unemployment Claims: DOL advance initial unemployment insurance claims, SA weekly level; not continuing claims.

aliases.title: Prelim UoM Consumer Sentiment
aliases.justification: FF Prelim UoM Consumer Sentiment: University of Michigan preliminary Consumer Sentiment Index, NSA level; not inflation expectations.

aliases.title: Revised UoM Consumer Sentiment
aliases.justification: FF Revised UoM Consumer Sentiment: University of Michigan final Consumer Sentiment Index, NSA level; FF revised denotes the final stage.

aliases.title: Consumer Confidence
aliases.justification: FF Consumer Confidence: European Commission euro-area consumer confidence, SA response balance in percentage points; stage comes from the reviewed edition.

aliases.title: Economic Sentiment
aliases.justification: FF Economic Sentiment: European Commission euro-area Economic Sentiment Indicator, SA index; excludes ZEW and Sentix surveys.

aliases.title: Core CPI Flash Estimate y/y
aliases.justification: FF Core CPI Flash Estimate y/y: Eurostat flash HICP excluding energy, food, alcohol and tobacco, NSA annual rate, EA21.

aliases.title: Final Core CPI y/y
aliases.justification: FF Final Core CPI y/y: Eurostat final HICP excluding energy, food, alcohol and tobacco, NSA annual rate, EA21.

aliases.title: CPI Flash Estimate y/y
aliases.justification: FF CPI Flash Estimate y/y: Eurostat flash headline HICP, NSA annual percent change, EA21.

aliases.title: Final CPI m/m
aliases.justification: FF Final CPI m/m: Eurostat final headline HICP, NSA monthly percent change, EA21.

aliases.title: New Home Sales
aliases.justification: FF New Home Sales: Census new single-family houses sold, SA annual rate, thousands of units; excludes existing home sales.

aliases.title: Retail Sales m/m
aliases.justification: FF Retail Sales m/m: ONS Great Britain retail sales volume including fuel, SA monthly percent change; not nominal sales or ex-fuel volume.

aliases.title: Trade Balance
aliases.justification: FF Trade Balance: Eurostat extra-euro-area goods balance, SA, millions of EUR; excludes national balances and the current account.

aliases.title: Industrial Production m/m
aliases.justification: FF Industrial Production m/m: Eurostat total industry excluding construction, SA monthly percent change, EA21.

aliases.title: Retail Sales m/m
aliases.justification: FF Retail Sales m/m: Eurostat total retail trade volume (deflated turnover), SA monthly percent change, EA21.

aliases.title: Unemployment Rate
aliases.justification: FF Unemployment Rate: Eurostat SA unemployment rate, ages 15-74, EA21.

aliases.title: Federal Funds Rate
aliases.justification: FF Federal Funds Rate: FOMC target range's upper bound in percent; the certified scalar is the upper bound, not the midpoint.

aliases.title: Deposit Facility Rate
aliases.justification: FF Deposit Facility Rate: ECB deposit facility rate, percent per annum; Main Refinancing Rate is a different instrument.

aliases.title: Official Bank Rate
aliases.justification: FF Official Bank Rate: Bank of England MPC Bank Rate, percent level.

aliases.title: BOJ Policy Rate
aliases.justification: FF BOJ Policy Rate: BOJ short-term uncollateralized overnight call policy rate, percent level.

aliases.title: 1-y Loan Prime Rate
aliases.justification: FF 1-y Loan Prime Rate: PBOC-authorized NIFC one-year Loan Prime Rate, percent; the certified scalar is 1Y, not the over-5Y tenor.

aliases.title: Overnight Rate
aliases.justification: FF Overnight Rate: Bank of Canada target for the overnight rate, percent level.
